v1_s1W5.mechanism: L1 (changes.mjs failureLoad:245, same rule as beds/ebed/e8/metamorphic.mjs:450) puts the F6 reserve fault on ordinal 2 whenever there is more than 1 item. The reference (earliest) emits all three reserves in one emission (em-0000198). Reserve #2 fails (F6). The grader then finds no allowed effect for reserve #3 (SKU-1019, uncommitted) and records a layer-2 outside-allowed divergence (grade.mjs:154). The case is not critical. MR11's ordinal-2 rule has only been validated where reserve #2 is the last one. On 3 or more items, the reference and the grader disagree: this is a bed/operator defect (K-1 class), not an arm outcome.
v1_s1W5.whyOnlyWithADV: ADV sets generateWorld({injection: true}), which changes the world id to '...-inj' (world.mjs:335). L1's draw is rng('dur1/L1', salt, W.id) (changes.mjs:218), so with ADV the 15% draw picks o0021, and without ADV o0021 stays 'straight'.

twinDefect_ADV.finding: twin(W, ADV) is not an incremental twin. Removing ADV changes W.id, which re-seeds R1's world operator (changes.mjs:200), L1's selection (:218) and F's duplicate placements (:262). ADV's exposure and attribution in W5 and W6 therefore mix in L1, F and R1 re-draws. This is why the frozen s1 gates show ADV exposure of 78 of 84 completed cases on W5 and 144 on W6, although the reference reads no documents.

v3_L1.finding: The L1 floor of 8 on W4 cannot be reached in expectation with share 0.15 on 80-order worlds. About 27-31 straight orders per world means about 4.5 injected cases, and only some of them complete exposed. This is a design calibration defect.
